name: Opportunity
fact: Mars Exploration Rover B — the marathon rover. 5,111 sols of active operation (over 14 years), 45.16 km traversed (the most by any vehicle on another world until Curiosity broke the cumulative record). Confirmed past liquid water at Endurance, Victoria, and Endeavour craters. During the final 2018 dust storm, the rover's last telemetry showed depleted power — a moment poetically paraphrased as "my battery is low and it's getting dark."
capability: Set the bar for rover endurance; established the field-geology playbook every subsequent rover has followed.
